❤️ ADIEU GTA V. LA FIN D'UNE ÉPOQUE.

Le 17 septembre 2013, GTA V débarquait dans nos vies. Michael, Franklin et Trevor nous embarquaient dans une aventure qui allait marquer toute une génération.

À cette époque, j'avais 24 ans. Aujourd'hui, j'en ai 37.

Aujourd'hui, une

Rockstar Games, Travis Scott and Nike are expected to collaborate on three Air Force 1 sneakers for GTA 6.

The sneakers are expected to release on November 19, the same day as GTA 6, for $130 each.

- White & Fire Pink
- Black & Fire Pink
- Multi-Color

95% complete until GTA 6 officially releases (19 days remaining).
GTA 6 is officially 2 Fridays out from launch.

All GTA 6 videos on Rockstar’s YouTube channel have surpassed 600 million views combined.

This makes up more than one third of their total channel views before the game is even out, which puts into perspective just how massive this release is for Rockstar.
